services.name: Set Sail on a 21-Foot Sea Pro Boat
services.desc: At Tidal Pursuits Fishing, we operate a 2001 21-foot Sea Pro center console that’s powered by a 150 HP Mercury outboard motor. Equipped with a jack plate and trolling motor, our boat can quietly navigate shallow waters, making it ideal for sight casting to a wide range of fish species. It can also accommodate up to four anglers, with ample seating for the journey between fishing spots. Additionally, it features an upper control station/tower and provides plenty of storage space for rods, tackle and personal items. blurb: Tidal Pursuits Fishing offers guided fishing charters in the Outer Banks of North Carolina, including inshore and nearshore trips. They specialize in seasonal fishing such as the March Striper Migration on the Roanoke River and target species like cobia, red drum, Spanish mackerel, flounder, speckled trout, and more. Trips accommodate 1-4 anglers with options for half-day, 3/4-day, and full-day excursions.
